name: GlobalSearch
description: Cross-model search behind one endpoint: a project registers named search sources, and a command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) queries every source the user is allowed to reach, grouped by type. Needs no search engine — a source is a closure returning a builder, so the default install is plain SQL.

per-user.label: Yes — recent searches per user (adds one table)

none.label: No — no table, no history endpoints

scout.prompt: Add the Laravel Scout source helper?

off.label: No — sources are plain builders (no dependency)

on.label: Yes — adds laravel/scout and a helper that builds a source from a Scout model
